text:
Lena (CEO): Hey team — quick all-hands tomorrow 10:00–11:00 PT. Agenda below, plus please drop questions in-thread or add to the Q&A doc by EOD today. Will post recording and notes after.

Lena (CEO): Agenda: 1) 10m Exec state and priorities; 2) 20m Product launch recap; 3) 15m Dedicated & Private roadmap highlights; 4) 10m Ops & reliability update; 5) 10m Open mic / lightning demos; 6) 5m Closing + action items.

Arun (VP Product): For the launch recap I'll share the telemetry snapshot and top 3 customer asks. If you have a demo (under 3 min) reply here and I'll slot you into the open mic.

Sam (Eng Dir): Quick note — we'll call out the short incidents from last week and the mitigation plan during the Ops slot. If you want deeper follow-up, file a ticket and tag eng-runtime.

Marta (PM): Q&A doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/allhands-qa-1811 (please add 1–2 lines max per question). We'll prioritize for the live session.

Jules (People Ops): Logistics: captions available, session will be hybrid (HQ + Zoom). Recording will go to #all-hands and the handbook page. If you need asynchronous input, DM me and I'll read it during the open mic.

Lena (CEO): Two asks before tomorrow: 1) add any talking points or demo links by 6pm PT; 2) upvote questions in the QA doc so we can triage.

Sam (Eng Dir): @Arun can you confirm if we should mention the soft rollout timeline for the new batching feature?

Arun (VP Product): Yes — we'll announce a phased rollout (canary next week -> full launch in 3 weeks) and the KPIs we're tracking (P50/P95 latency, token cost).

Marta (PM): Added a short customer excerpt to the doc that shows the cost savings pattern.

Jules (People Ops): Heads up — we'll record the meeting and add speaker timestamps to the notes. Also planning a 15-min followup office hours for product/eng questions.

Lena (CEO): Great — thanks everyone. If anything changes I'll post an update here. See you tomorrow.
